biography.plain_text: Steve Trulaske is the second-generation owner and chief executive of True Manufacturing, the Missouri refrigeration business founded by his father and family in 1945. After joining in 1982, he helped build the company's international reach while sustaining its American manufacturing base. He also funds international-study programs through his alma mater, DePauw University.

long_biography.plain_text:
Trulaske entered True Manufacturing in 1982, following his father Robert J. Trulaske Sr. and brother Robert Jr. into the family enterprise. He concentrated on international growth, establishing operations in Spain, Korea and Canada while the Missouri-based refrigeration manufacturer added production capacity at home. That work helped turn a domestic company into a broadly distributed international business.

As owner and chief executive, he has continued True's emphasis on in-house manufacturing while backing lower-energy equipment and natural refrigerants. His public service has included university trusteeship and educational giving. At DePauw, a major endowment created international-study scholarships and sustains the Servicio en las Américas program, covering program expenses for selected first-year students.
